requiredUniqueness.scope: eligible slot range must be established by client/source evidence; owned and concept entries participate
requiredUniqueness.blocker: do not invent exclusion exceptions or silently discard legacy conflicts

requiredPartialUniqueIndexes.purpose: At most one default design per type
One active player listing per native seller item

requiredPartialUniqueIndexes.predicate: identity_status = 'resolved' AND native_footballer_id IS NOT NULL
requiredPartialUniqueIndexes.evidenceRequired: resolve actual footballer identity before activation

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: Exactly one required family child at commit, matching parent family. Player/manager/consumable/customization definitions have their typed definition children; token definition has no invented family child. Owned items have exactly their selected family child.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Check inserts, updates, deletes on parent and every family child; permit temporary insertion-order gaps within one transaction, reject inconsistent commit.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: family_id matches referenced item definition; owned children derive owner/definition/footballer through parent.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Revalidate changes to item family/definition and definition family, including concurrent writers.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: Owned item must belong to squads.club_id and match declared definition/family.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Check membership and item/squad owner/definition changes on both sides; use reviewed row locks for concurrent changes.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: footballer_id matches referenced player card definition. Owned and concept versions use same identity.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Check memberships and card definition identity changes; do not enforce unverified native mappings as truth.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: Owned kind requires an owned reference; concept/verified virtual kind has no owned reference and requires sourced wire/default identity.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Local CHECK where possible plus deferred cross-row validation; no fabricated owned items for defaults.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: Referenced squad_player_id belongs to the role squad or tactic squad. Roles render slot from validated membership.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Check assignment and membership/tactic reparenting; preserve valid swap/empty-slot behavior.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: Item belongs to club and matches definition, native kind/subtype and slot compatibility.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Check changes on both sides; lock/refuse according to existing equipment rules; rules stay source of slot eligibility.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: selected_choice_id belongs to this token and selection occurs exactly once with grant/delete lifecycle in the same transaction.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Deferred same-token validation plus atomic selection/idempotency; replay must not generate new choices.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: Retained stack quantity > 0 and 0 <= untradeable_quantity <= quantity.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Final consumption deletes empty stack; keep aliases amount/stackCount derived.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: credits >= 0 and fifa_points >= 0.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Preserve existing version-5 checks and atomic market/pack/account behavior.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: native_item_id > 0, preserving existing stored positive-ID invariant.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Audit imported storage/document disagreement; no automatic renumbering of wire documents or reference loss.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: scope current/lifetime and supported stat bounds; values clamp nonnegative only as current converter does.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: playerStatSlots comes from current rules; preserve unknown index meanings and conversion behavior.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: Resolved applied style is the applicable chemistry-style consumable, and position/league overrides obey traced rules.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Validate source-specific compatibility and update both definition/state changes; no arbitrary FK to any consumable.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: kind player implies positive seller_item_id and non-null seller_club_id; kind ai implies both null.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Copy current ClubSchema version-5 exact behavior; historical seller_item_id remains native club-local number.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: state in active, closed, expired, cancelled.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Preserve current listing lifecycle; no new states inferred from words in documentation.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: starting_bid >= 0; buy_now >= starting_bid; current_bid >= 0; sold_price >= 0; offers >= 0.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Preserve version-5 contract.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: Active listing with current_bid != 0 requires bidder_club_id; active end_time > created_at.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Preserve version-5 contract.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: Active player listing resolves seller_club_id/seller_item_id to actual player inventory with matching definition and reviewed escrow state.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Preserve global market advisory lock and club lock order; historical closed listing must survive seller item deletion.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: Snapshot preserves every transferred/displayed field and does not change after publication; definition_revision alone is not an archived base-attribute snapshot.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Choose explicit immutable revision history or sufficient typed frozen definition data before mutable catalog updates; prove old listings survive update/delete.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: Native search projections agree with immutable listing snapshot and current JsonValues conversion contracts.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Do not FK native market nation_id/league_id/team_id to internal dimension IDs; version-6 behavior remains observable.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: run_id identifies parent; reset/version change atomically replaces prior run children and rejects stale generation.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Draft choices/picks are virtual; preserve native wire IDs, stable order and current AUD-DB-008 unresolved retry key.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: Zero/historical/virtual loan/badge wire IDs and duplicate/order semantics are retained.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Do not add unconditional FK from stale wire IDs to current inventory or invent resolved items.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: Unknown JSON never overrides canonical typed decision fields; match_settlements.response remains immutable retry payload.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Explicit field retention classifications; do not recreate whole live item documents as hidden authority.

requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.rule: Definition deletion cannot cascade into owned inventory. Quick sell cannot cascade through a saved squad to bypass current refusal.
requiredCrossRowAndLifecycleInvariants.implementation: Specify every FK ON DELETE/UPDATE from actual lifecycle; family and owned feature cleanup follow parent where safe, historical snapshots/import hashes survive appropriate deletion.

secondaryIndexCandidates.purpose: Inventory filters, counts and native-order paging
Family inventory; only if actual predicates justify it
Reverse equipped kit guard if needed
Existing search index; reassess against version-6 predicates
Pack grant lookup and stable paging

additionalIndexRules: Do not duplicate PK/UQ-covered prefixes without measured need.
Inventory referencing FK columns; decide supporting indexes from real parent-delete, join and guard queries.
Do not index every attribute/stat/JSON column.
Use EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) on disposable multi-club/skewed fixtures with refreshed statistics.
Record storage size, write amplification, actual rows, buffers, sort, latency, SQL count and fetched bytes.
The partial eligible-footballer invariant requires verified slot scope; do not invent a WHERE slot_index predicate.
concurrencyRequirements: Deferred validation must cover both endpoints of every mutable relationship.
Acquire parent/owner/reference locks in consistent reviewed order; demonstrate competing transactions cannot commit invalid references.
No application-only ownership guarantee and no new global all-inventory write lock introduced as a convenience.
Permit legal squad swaps without transient uniqueness failure; preserve idempotent claim ON CONFLICT behavior when choosing deferrability.
